name: Unnerving Silence
label: Quest
description: Unnerving Silence: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A moment if you will, friend. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.
With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able, go seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
